long_biography.plain_text:
Dan Beșciu's partnership with Sorin Vulpescu extended beyond roadbuilding. The two owned Bucharest's Golden Blitz restaurant and founded the Fly Taxi venture. Euro Construct Trading '98, however, became the centre of Beșciu's business life, undertaking road maintenance, bridge and railway projects across Romania.

Beșciu held a direct stake in the construction firm and represented it on public contracts. Its activities broadened to civil engineering, asphalt materials and waste-management services. During judicial reorganisation he served as special administrator under a court-appointed practitioner's supervision. Its environmental services include treating soil contaminated with petroleum products.
